summary.plain: The Bern-based group that developed and operated ORPHEUS, a dark matter detector made of superheated superconducting tin granules.
summary.technical: Authors of the ORPHEUS first-results paper (arXiv:astro-ph/0404311) are at the Laboratory for High Energy Physics of the University of Bern; reviews by K. Pretzl (Bern) speak of 'the ORPHEUS collaboration'.
